statement: A peripheral-class-preserving automorphism of a free profinite or free pro-l group of affine type (g,n) has determinant lambda^(g+n-1).
notes: Includes primes 2 and 3 and once-punctured curves.

statement: A nontrivial procyclic subgroup with open arithmetic normalizer image and a finite cyclotomic twist at one nontrivial prime component lies in a genuine cusp inertia group.
depends_on: Nakamura1994 Theorem2.1.1 and Lemma2.1.4; BoggiZalesskii2019 Proposition3.6
notes: Maximality makes it equal to inertia; full profinite and explicitly sourced geometrically pro-l forms.

statement: Every affine hyperbolic curve over a number field has a unique Galois-invariant peripheral loop structure in the automorphism orbit of its standard one.
notes: Settles LM3 D23 first half, including (1,1); distinct from an arbitrary procyclic subgroup.

statement: Every maximal procyclic subgroup of the full geometric profinite group with open arithmetic normalizer image is cuspidal, without any condition on its exponent character.
notes: Attack gives weight-one/weight-two dichotomy. Missing implication is potential cyclotomicity of one prime component; smallest remaining case is a once-punctured elliptic curve.

statement: The bare open-normalizer recognition criterion on the class-two pro-5 quotient of the once-punctured elliptic curve y^2=x^3-x over Q(i) is false.
notes: Primitive CM eigenline lifts to a maximal procyclic subgroup in the class-two quotient with full normalizer image; no full-group counterexample asserted.

statement: The localized tripod functor on cofinal opens of M0,5 with the restricted maps s,t,t-s has automorphism group G_Q and characterizes its restriction inside the GT containers.
notes: Complete rigidity reduction; infinitely many opens are essential.

statement: The maximal closed AA subgroups in GT are exactly the GT-conjugates of G_Q, with the specified arithmetic-Belyi, Kummer and configuration data.
notes: A marking selects one subgroup from the conjugacy class; predicate exceeds two isolated levels.

statement: The arithmetic G_Q is self-commensurating in the label-preserving outer automorphism container; its full-outer commensurator is G_Q times S3.
notes: Also proves trivial centralizers of every open subgroup of either GT container.

statement: The stabilizer of the actual geometric-section image family with arithmetic domains retained equals G_Q in GT and, using the tripod level, in GT0.
notes: Explicit typing hypothesis; does not recognize unmarked admissible sections or prove section surjectivity.

statement: The marked section stabilizer transports Kummer classes and satisfies the Nakamura-Schneps III-prime and IV relations, with rho2 the specified Kummer cocycle.
notes: Cohomology classes, not canonical cocycle representatives.

statement: For a hyperbolic curve U over a number field, the centralizer of its arithmetic Galois image in Out(pi1 geometric) is Aut_K(U), with explicit requested low-type groups.
notes: Includes nonsplit conic qualification in type(0,4), and exact mu2/mu4/mu6 forms in type(1,1).

statement: For odd l the Galois centralizers for geometric M0,m are S3 at m4 and Sm at m>=5, and the specified Lie centralizer is Sm for m>=5.
notes: Centre-free arithmetic-to-outer reduction supplied; no unsupported l2 extension.

statement: The category of hyperbolic K-curves with dominant maps is fully faithfully described by open arithmetic fundamental-group homomorphisms modulo target geometric inner automorphisms.
notes: Constants require geometric point sections; tangential sections remain boundary data.

statement: The essential image is obtained from open subgroups of the arithmetic tripod by filling a Galois-stable subset of cusps, with hyperbolicity retained.
depends_on: Belyi1980 Theorem4 proof; etale cover classification
notes: Rational polynomial postcompositions give the construction over the original number field, with prescribed boundary.

statement: In a toric analytic uniformization, pulling an analytic torus lift back along multiplication by m gives m-th roots of all its characters on the entire pullback.
depends_on: Discrete torsion-free period lattice; algebraic closure of coefficient field
notes: All positive m, including those divisible by residue characteristic.

statement: Manuscript019 Proposition5.2 holds: the auxiliary cover has ramification indices dividing an odd l different from p, and T has an m-th root on every inverse middle-annulus component.
depends_on: G.1; BakerRabinoff2015 sections4.1-4.2 and4.5.2, Proposition6.1, Corollary6.6
notes: Requested audit closed; p2 and p dividing m included. Q is connected over k as stated, not additionally asserted geometrically connected.

statement: Manuscript031 Lemma3.1 holds with m>n(n-1), including its polynomial zero estimate and logarithm-rank conclusion.
depends_on: Affine Bezout; interpolation determinant; product formula; dg_checks.py
notes: No Leopoldt assumption; strict exponent checked for n2..50 in independent code.

statement: The finite quotient used in031 Proposition4.3 has signed characters separating every proper subgroup of a cyclic group while escaping the kernel-conjugate invariant spaces.
depends_on: Regular F2-module Kummer amplification; equivariant Dirichlet; semisimplicity
notes: No splitting of the auxiliary extension and no Leopoldt dimension assumption needed.

statement: Manuscript031 Proposition4.3 holds: suitable infinitely many active Frobenius images generate the prescribed cyclic subgroup after enlarging the finite quotient.
depends_on: G.3;G.4; Uchida1981 section1 and Proposition1; Chebotarev
notes: Only U-equivariant projection is needed, not normality of T.

statement: Manuscript031 Proposition5.3 holds: missed primes away from l number at most2[K:Q], and all missed primes at most2[K:Q]+2 uniformly in l.
depends_on: Uchida1981 local trichotomy; Kummer completion; equivariant S-unit characters; G.7
notes: Bound independent of the degree of the finite cyclotomic-twist extension.

statement: The normalizer extension beta in031 is surjective and has equal cyclotomic logarithms for every odd l congruent1 modulo[k:Q]!, proving its Theorem4.4.
depends_on: G.3;G.5; Uchida1979 main theorem; Uchida1981 local trichotomy; Dirichlet
notes: Additional checked consequence. Full019/031 theorems remain author claims outside this targeted audit; no gap inferred from audit scope.
